serverWakingUp: Waking up backend server (Render free tier cold start ~50s)...
serverConnected: Backend server and database connected successfully!
serverConnectedDbPaused: Backend is active, but Supabase database appears paused.
dbPausedNotice: If the Supabase project itself is paused, database activities (login, profiles, saved data) will not work, but non-DB features (Weather, AI Advisory) remain active.
freeTierBannerShort: Notice: Free-tier Render backend takes ~50s to wake up. If Supabase DB is paused, DB-related features won't work, while rest of backend works.
renderNoticeDesc: The backend is hosted on Render's free tier. Inactive instances spin down and require ~50 seconds to boot on first request.
supabaseNoticeDesc: The PostgreSQL database is hosted on Supabase free tier. Inactive projects may be paused. While paused, database-dependent features (User Authentication, Saved Farms, Market Listings, Grievance tracking) will not work until unpaused in Supabase.
demoVideoDesc: If the live project or database is currently paused, a complete recorded demonstration of Version 1 in action is available on YouTube.
powered_by: Powered by AI with support from Agriculture Department, Govt. of India
